_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Draft compiled 2026-09-26. NDLEA’s August release names Afolabi and Lawal; its 25 September charge report names three arraigned Nigerian defendants and separately names two alleged co-conspirators arrested in London. BBC reports the two London defendants faced UK charges related to a distinct UK cocaine seizure, while Nigerian authorities later alleged their involvement in the Nigerian export conspiracy. These allegations and proceedings are not convictions. Nigeria markers apply only to four people with directly alleged Nigerian network activity; the UK pair have blank regions because UK arrest/charges in a separate seizure do not establish their operational country within this Nigerian network. One pairwise link is drawn only from an explicit procurement allegation. No other links from co-defendant listing, exact routes or addresses, present locations, or portraits without file-level rights are included.
